name: molecular-modeling-workbench
description: Auditable WSL-native onboarding, molecular docking, visualization, and molecular dynamics workflows.

interface.longDescription: Beginner-guided Windows-to-WSL onboarding plus reproducible, file-based GNINA/Vina docking, complex analysis, ChimeraX/PyMOL visualization, validated docking-to-MD handoffs, and GROMACS workflow orchestration.
defaultPrompt: Guide me through the Windows 11 to Ubuntu 22.04 WSL2 onboarding checklist without making privileged changes.
Audit my WSL2 GPU molecular-modeling environment before docking.
Run a reproducible GNINA docking workflow with Vina fallback.
Validate a selected docking pose before starting ligand MD.
